name: Yomichi de Chijo ni Nerawareru
original_name: 夜道で痴女に狙われる
source:
The stranger that showed up on the way home turned out to be a female molester?!

Boku left cram school especially late tonight.
While walking alone, in the dead of night, he suddenly meets a beautiful lady.

But wait... something seems to be wrong with her...

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ426247.html]DLsite[/url]]
